The main takeaway from our work is that
HLA-DQA typing is an excellent predictor of MLC results among unrelated HLA-identicals and that the DQA1* gene is a major determinant in the MLC reaction.
HLA-DQA typing is useful in screening samples prior to performing mixed lymphocyte culture.
